اقتطعتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَعَتَا (iqtaṭaʕatā) /iq.ta.tˤa.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اُقْتُطِعَتَا (uqtuṭiʕatā) /uq.tu.tˤi.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
